title: Tabbi sync document (schemaVersion 1)
description: The one document Sign in with Apple keeps per account on the Party server (GET and PUT /v1/sync, docs/study/backend-api.md): the pet's look, points per device, unlock ids, study days and the longest streak. Written by SyncDocument.encoded() and read by SyncDocument.decode(_:) in Sources/TabbiKitCore/Sync/SyncDocument.swift; every app (Mac, Windows) reads and writes the same document, and the server stores it as sent (at most 65536 bytes with its {"document": ...} wrapper) without reading its fields. This schema describes what an app writes. Readers are lenient: a missing or unreadable field reads as empty, so one bad value never loses the rest; unknown keys are ignored and dropped on the next write, which is why no object here forbids additional properties. Merging two documents is a join (per-device tallies by max, unlocks and study days by union, the longest streak by max, the pet by last writer); shared/fixtures/sync-document/ pins it.

schemaVersion.description: The format version. Apps write 1; a document without one counts as 0 and is read the same way, since version 1 needed no migration step.

pet.description: The pet's look as last chosen on any device. Left out until a device with a pet has synced. A pet a reader cannot decode (an unknown breed, a bad date) reads as no pet.

tallies.description: Lifetime points per device, keyed by each device's sync id (a UUID string the device made). Each device only grows its own tally, so a merge takes the larger of each counter and the account's points are the sum over devices. A reader drops the whole object when any tally in it is unreadable.

unlocks.description: Item ids bought or granted on any device (outfit.<id> or accessory.<id>), sorted. Ids this build does not know are kept, so an item from a newer build survives a round trip. Limited edition ids read back as granted, the rest as bought; free items are never listed by the Mac but are harmless.

studyDays.description: Local days (of whichever device recorded them) with focus time, sorted, at most the newest 400. Strings that are not a real calendar day in this exact form are dropped on read.

longestStreak.description: The longest run of consecutive study days ever reached, including days since trimmed; never less than the longest run in studyDays.

itemId.description: A Closet item id: outfit.<PetOutfit raw value> or accessory.<PetAccessory raw value>.

day.description: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, zero padded.

hexColor.description: Uppercase #RRGGBB, plus AA when not fully opaque.

tally.description: What one device added to the shared points: lifetime earned and spent. A device writes its own tally as 0 or more; a negative value read from a document is kept as it is until a merge with another copy of that device's tally clamps it to 0. Spent may exceed earned; the account's ledger caps spent at earned.

updatedAt.description: When the look was chosen: ISO 8601 in UTC, whole seconds (fractions are cut off before writing). The later look wins a merge; on equal times the profile whose compact, key-sorted JSON is the greater string wins, so every device converges.

profile.description: The pet as PetProfile encodes it. Only breed is needed to read it; every other field falls back to a default.

name.description: Whitespace trimmed and collapsed, cut to 16 characters unless it is a breed's display name; never empty (an empty name becomes the breed's display name).

breed.description: A PetBreed raw value, such as britishShorthair or goldenRetriever.

paletteOverrides.description: User colors per recolorable palette role. A document without furTint is from before fur tints: its furBase override is read as the tint and the other fur roles are dropped.

furTint.description: The one fur color picked in the Closet, or null for the breed's own colors. Always written, so a missing key means an older document.

outfit.description: A PetOutfit raw value; none when no outfit is worn.

accessories.description: PetAccessory raw values worn, at most one per slot, in drawing order.
